name: academiasync
description: Learning management system: a Next.js frontend, two Express services and PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend/user-service ci && npm --prefix backend/course-service ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend/user-service test && npm --prefix backend/course-service test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend/user-service run test:coverage && npm --prefix backend/course-service run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend/user-service run lint && npm --prefix backend/course-service run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend/user-service run format:check && npm --prefix backend/course-service run format:check
